dedupe_keys.name: global site specific health impacts of fossil power plants steel mills oil refineries and cement plants

description: This data set is a site-by-site emission and health impact inventory for nearly all fossil power plants, steel mills, oil refineries and cement plants worldwide. It is the supplementary data of a 2023 Scientific Reports paper, deposited on Zenodo by Christopher Oberschelp, and links measured emissions of carbon dioxide, fine particulate matter, sulphur dioxide, nitrogen oxides and ammonia with site-specific technical data, emission models and atmospheric fate and effect models to estimate each site's health impacts. The authors highlight coal-consuming sites in densely populated parts of Asia, Western Europe and the United States, high sulphur dioxide emissions in India from missing flue gas treatment, and a European phase-out that has not started with the sites of greatest impact. Coverage is global. The data are one Excel workbook of about 15 MB, downloadable from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: impacts are model estimates, and the inventory reflects the paper's reference year. Simulation uses are prioritising plant retirements or abatement by health impact and linking energy assets to exposed populations. Related records: data-gem-global-coal-plant-tracker lists coal units with status and owners.
name: Global site-specific health impacts of fossil power plants, steel mills, oil refineries and cement plants
